strands.name: Strand A: Scientific Investigation Skills and Career Exploration

overalls.title: Scientific Investigation Skills
overalls.description: demonstrate scientific investigation skills (related to both inquiry and research) in the four areas of skills (initiating and planning, performing and recording, analysing and interpreting, and communicating)

specifics.description: I can ask scientific questions, make predictions, and plan safe investigations using appropriate procedures and equipment.
I can conduct experiments, collect accurate data, and organize it using tables, graphs, and diagrams.
I can analyse and interpret data, identify sources of error and bias, and draw conclusions supported by evidence.
I can communicate my findings clearly using scientific language, appropriate formats, and precise measurements.

overalls.title: Career Exploration
overalls.description: identify and describe careers related to the fields of science under study, and describe the contributions of scientists, including Canadians, to those fields

specifics.description: I can identify physics-related careers and describe Canadian contributions to physics.

overalls.title: Relating Science to Technology, Society, and the Environment
overalls.description: analyse technologies that apply concepts related to kinematics, and assess them considering social and environmental impacts

specifics.description: I can evaluate motion technologies (transportation, sports equipment, speed enforcement) and their impacts.

overalls.title: Developing Skills of Investigation and Communication
overalls.description: investigate, in qualitative and quantitative terms, uniform and non-uniform linear motion, and solve related problems

specifics.description: I can construct and interpret position-time, velocity-time, and acceleration-time graphs.
I can solve kinematics equations for uniform and accelerated motion in 1D and 2D.

overalls.title: Understanding Basic Concepts
overalls.description: demonstrate an understanding of uniform and non-uniform linear motion

specifics.description: I can distinguish between scalar and vector quantities (distance vs displacement, speed vs velocity).

overalls.title: Relating Science to Technology, Society, and the Environment
overalls.description: analyse technological devices that apply concepts related to forces, and assess their social and environmental impacts

specifics.description: I can evaluate vehicle safety features and force applications in structural design.

overalls.title: Developing Skills of Investigation and Communication
overalls.description: investigate, in qualitative and quantitative terms, net force, acceleration, and friction, and solve related problems

specifics.description: I can draw free-body diagrams and apply Newton's Laws of Motion to calculate net force, acceleration, and friction.

overalls.title: Understanding Basic Concepts
overalls.description: demonstrate an understanding of Newton's laws of motion, friction, and gravitational force

specifics.description: I can explain Newton's Three Laws of Motion, universal gravitation, and normal/friction forces.

overalls.title: Relating Science to Technology, Society, and the Environment
overalls.description: analyse technologies that apply concepts related to energy transformation, and assess them considering social and environmental impacts

specifics.description: I can evaluate energy production technologies, energy efficiency, and societal impacts of energy consumption.

overalls.title: Developing Skills of Investigation and Communication
overalls.description: investigate energy transformations and thermal energy, and solve related problems

specifics.description: I can perform quantitative calculations involving work, kinetic energy, gravitational potential energy, mechanical energy conservation, and thermal energy (Q = mcΔT).

overalls.title: Understanding Basic Concepts
overalls.description: demonstrate an understanding of work, efficiency, energy transformations, and thermal energy transfer

specifics.description: I can explain the Law of Conservation of Energy, mechanical work, power, and thermal energy mechanisms.

overalls.title: Relating Science to Technology, Society, and the Environment
overalls.description: analyse how mechanical waves and sound affect technology, society, and the environment

specifics.description: I can evaluate acoustic technologies, noise pollution impacts, and medical ultrasound applications.

overalls.title: Developing Skills of Investigation and Communication
overalls.description: investigate properties of mechanical waves and sound, and solve related problems

specifics.description: I can calculate wave speed (v = fλ), frequency, period, and analyze standing waves and resonance in air columns and strings.

overalls.title: Understanding Basic Concepts
overalls.description: demonstrate an understanding of wave properties, interference, sound propagation, and the Doppler effect

specifics.description: I can explain transverse and longitudinal wave phenomena, constructive/destructive interference, and the Doppler effect.

overalls.title: Relating Science to Technology, Society, and the Environment
overalls.description: analyse social, economic, and environmental implications of electrical power generation and electromagnetism

specifics.description: I can evaluate electromagnetic devices (motors, generators, transformers) and electrical power distribution.

overalls.title: Developing Skills of Investigation and Communication
overalls.description: investigate magnetic fields and electric circuits, and solve related problems

specifics.description: I can analyze DC circuits using Kirchhoff's Laws and Ohm's Law, and map magnetic fields using right-hand rules.

overalls.title: Understanding Basic Concepts
overalls.description: demonstrate an understanding of magnetic fields, electromagnetism, and electric circuits

specifics.description: I can explain Oersted's principle, motor principle, Faraday's law of electromagnetic induction, and magnetic domain theory.
